title: Who Moved My Cheese - Haw's Run and the Reunion's Lesson
summary: An 8-page right-to-left manga dramatizing Haw's escape from fear into the Maze, his empty-handed return to a resistant Hem, his joyful discovery of Cheese Station N alongside Sniff and Scurry, and a framed reunion discussion where Michael and his classmates translate the parable into action at work, in family life, and in themselves. All three ContextPack source units are cited and all three canon facts are referenced across the beats.

beats.book_essence: Haw pauses before a darkened corridor, his fear conjuring imagined dangers, but he remembers he felt best in the Maze when he was moving, then chooses to act as if he were not afraid.
beats.dramatization: An establishing shot of a yawning black corridor swallows Haw's small figure. Sweat beads on his brow. His chalk scrapes a message for Hem across the wall. He squares his shoulders and steps in, breaking the held breath of the previous slice.

beats.dramatization: Haw's laughter echoes across a sequence of medium shots as he runs. The corridor lights shift from oppressive black to a cool blue breeze; his pace quickens. Page reads right-to-left so the run reads naturally toward the page turn.

beats.dramatization: A reveal page: Haw rounds the corner and the panel floods with Cheese. Sniff nods, Scurry waves a paw; their plump bellies signal they have been here some time. Haw's eyes widen and he begins to feast.

ending_state: In Haw's narrative thread, he has filled Cheese Station N with New Cheese, written a summary of his lessons on the largest wall, and now listens to footsteps in the Maze - wondering if Hem will finally round the corner. In the reunion thread, Michael's story has reframed how his classmates see themselves and their organizations: peer pressure has flipped so no one wants to look like Hem, Jessica has left to find some New Cheese, and the group disperses carrying the conviction that an organization - like a person - can only change when enough people in it change.
